dedupe_keys.name: definitive healthcare hospitalview and facility databases us hospitals clinics long term care imaging surgery centres

description: Definitive Healthcare is a data and analytics company focused on the business side of US healthcare. Its View Suite profiles healthcare facilities and organisations. Coverage: the United States; HospitalView profiles every hospital and integrated delivery network, stated as more than 9,300 distinct hospital and health system profiles curated from primary research, public sources and de-identified all-payer claims, with system affiliations and parent-child structures, diagnosis and procedure claims by hospital, episodic care performance, technology installations by category, vendor and product, and financial metrics including bed counts, square footage and department changes; sister products cover more than 60,000 clinics, more than 100,000 nursing, assisted living, home health and hospice organisations, over 22,000 imaging centres, surgery centres, 130,000 physician groups, over 3 million clinicians and 4,500 accountable care, health information exchange and payer organisations. Format and access: a subscription web platform with market searches and segments, demos, quotes and trials; underlying data access is offered. Licence: commercial; not read. Caveats: built for sales and market intelligence, so fields that matter for infrastructure models (backup power, exact coordinates, surge capacity) were not confirmed; prices not published on the pages read. Simulation uses: hospital and care facility inventories with bed counts and affiliations for critical facility exposure, healthcare service capacity and emergency response models. Related records: the open CMS hospital provider data (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals) and HIFLD Open (data-hifld-open).
